Reconcile the explorer returns into a candidate AI assurance/certification-readiness thesis. Read-only skeptic. Attack the candidate assurance/certification-readiness thesis with the precedent gate. Distinguish external standards language, already-owned internal language, owned-adjacent repo evidence, market precedent, and build-from-owned opportunities. Precedent is not a kill; it labels ownership and narrows novelty. Verify whether the missing term is already in the repo as assurance, governance proof package, attestation, verifier, audit readiness, conformance, or another term. Do not write files. Budget about 4000 tokens.

Read-only skeptic. Attack the candidate assurance/certification-readiness thesis with the non-vacuity gate. Kill or downgrade any certification, assurance, auditability, correctness, compliance, or trust claim that lacks a concrete witness: receipt, log, validation report, verifier specimen, buyer workflow, auditable artifact, owner decision, or external-standard mapping. Force a vocabulary ladder where each term has a distinct role and evidence boundary. Do not write files. Budget about 4000 tokens.

Write findings.md only from the converged synthesis and reviewer results. Include: executive result, the best vocabulary family, standards-alignment table, local evidence map, compounding POC thesis, assurance/certification-readiness ladder, BP-safe language, forbidden claims, and next witness queue. Every load-bearing claim must cite source paths or explorer/reviewer evidence. Make clear this is not legal advice and does not claim current certification. Do not write research.md. Evaluate findings.md only. Check that it answers the hidden certification-vocabulary question, preserves claim <= proof, cites source evidence, separates standards alignment from legal advice, separates assurance/readiness from certification/correctness, describes the compounding effect of POCs without claiming finished platform, and respects public/private boundaries. Recommend accept or one bounded writer revision. Budget about 3500 tokens.
